GrandCare browser OCR assets

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 browser ESM and worker: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 WebAssembly engine: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- English fast trained data 4.0.0: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
- PDF.js 6.4.299: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

License texts are included beside the assets. OCR, PDF text extraction, and scanned-PDF rendering use local assets served by the GrandCare app.
